name: baseline
change: Baseline: no training, greedy decoding, CREATE TABLE statements as the schema

name: sft-spider
change: LoRA fine-tuning on Spider train: 6,142 examples of at most 1,024 tokens, 3 epochs

name: sft-spider-vote5
change: Same model as sft-spider; five candidate queries per question, keeping the result most candidates agree on

name: sft-spider-all
change: LoRA fine-tuning on Spider train plus train_others: 7,800 examples, 3 epochs, one greedy query

name: sft-spider-all-vote5
change: Same model as sft-spider-all; vote over five candidate queries

name: sft-rows1
change: LoRA fine-tuning with one example row per table in the schema: 5,259 examples, one greedy query

name: sft-rows1-vote5
change: Same model as sft-rows1; vote over five candidate queries

name: vote-of-three
change: Vote across the three fine-tuned models' voted answers (15 candidate queries per question in total)

name: sft-rows1-vote15
change: Same model as sft-rows1, voting over 15 candidate queries instead of 5

name: sft-synsql
change: Fresh LoRA on Spider train plus a SynSQL-2.5M slice (12,215 examples that fit 1,024 tokens, 6,000 synthetic databases), 2 epochs, one greedy query

name: sft-synsql-hints
change: Same model as sft-synsql; the prompt also lists question words found in the database's text values (value hints), one greedy query

name: sft-rows1-hints
change: Same model as sft-rows1 (one example row per table); value hints added to the prompt, one greedy query

name: vote-hints-three
change: Several models: vote across three fine-tuned adapters (sft-synsql with value hints, sft-rows1 with 15 candidates, sft-spider-all with 5), same majority rule as before

name: grpo600-hints
change: RL pilot: GRPO from sft-synsql on 600 fresh SynSQL questions (only 252 fit 900 prompt tokens), lr 2e-5, value hints, one greedy query

name: grpo-spider600-hints
change: RL pilot: GRPO from sft-synsql on 600 Spider train questions, lr 2e-5, value hints, one greedy query

name: grpo-lr5-2400-hints
change: GRPO from sft-synsql on 2,400 Spider train questions, lr 5e-6, value hints, one greedy query (65.38% at 800, 65.76% at 1,600)

name: vote-hints-three-rows
change: Several models: same three adapters as vote-hints-three, vote over each model's pick with empty and all-NULL results last; rule confirmed on 1,230 unseen Spider test questions (71.14% to 72.20%)

name: sft-hintstrained
change: Trained with value hints in the prompt (Spider + SynSQL slice, 2 epochs), greedy

name: sft-hintstrained-vote15
change: Same hints-trained model, vote over 15 candidates

name: vote-hintstrained-three
change: Three models vote (hints-trained with 15 candidates, one-row model with 15, all-Spider model with 5), empty results last

name: sft-rows1-shared15
change: Same model as sft-rows1-vote15, sampled again with the shared-prompt sampler so that its 15 candidates are saved

name: sft-spider-all-shared5
change: Same model as sft-spider-all-vote5, sampled again with the shared-prompt sampler so that its 5 candidates are saved

name: sft-hintstrained-greedy-repaired
change: One greedy query of the hints-trained model; a query that fails on a missing column is repaired from the database (minnow.repair)

name: sft-hintstrained-repaired
change: Same 15 candidates as sft-hintstrained-vote15, voted again with empty results last, then repaired where a column was missing

name: vote-three-repaired
change: Several models: hints-trained (15 candidates), sft-rows1-shared15 and sft-spider-all-shared5, each voted again with empty results last and repaired, then a vote over their picks; 72.82% on the same candidates without these two steps
